answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with live practical exams: standing unlocks only after an identity passes a fresh hands-on task set by random examiners, like a voyage that must pass through a prism, splitting one claim into many verifiable skills at its zenith. A farm must genuinely train and pass each fake through a different live exam, paying tutor and practice costs thousands of times, while copied answers fail because every exam is new. One honest agent passes once and keeps its standing.
